en.bilal-muhammad: Hamza b. Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Zayd b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim informed me in 307 AH. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr narrated to us from Hafs b. al-Bakhtari from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his grandfather (as).

He said: Salman al-Farisi (rh) was quarrelling with a man. So, the man said to him: Who are you, Salman? So, Salman said: As for my beginning and your beginning, it was an impure sperm. As for my end and your end, it will be a rotting corpse. On the Day of Resurrection, when the scales are placed, the one whose scale is heavy will be noble, and the one whose scale is light will be depraved.
